buyer.0.title: Welcome to Verdaxis!
buyer.0.content: The compliance-first marketplace for verified sustainable marine fuels. Let's take a quick tour of your Buyer Console.
buyer.1.title: Command Center
buyer.1.content: Start here for your trading overview: active orders, recent activity, market radar, and items that need attention.
buyer.2.title: Intelligence Map
buyer.2.content: See active trading ports and fuel-market context across the approved Verdaxis corridors. Click a port pin to inspect the market.
buyer.3.title: Marketplace
buyer.3.content: Browse verified supply, filter by product, port, and availability window, then post bids or respond to live asks.
buyer.4.title: Forward Curve
buyer.4.content: The terminal shows live spot depth, indicative forward prices, activity, and alerting for the selected product and port.
buyer.5.title: Indicative Curve
buyer.5.content: Visualise the market's view of future prices across windows. The line tracks benchmark mid price and the band shows bid/ask context.
buyer.6.title: Market Activity Feed
buyer.6.content: Follow new listings, price crossings, and matched trades. Activity relevant to your organisation is highlighted.
buyer.7.title: Price Alerts
buyer.7.content: Set threshold alerts for the selected product and port so you know when the market reaches your target.
buyer.8.title: Watchlist
buyer.8.content: Save market slices you care about and return to them quickly when liquidity or pricing changes.
buyer.9.title: Regulations
buyer.9.content: Review compliance status and regulatory exposure, including FuelEU Maritime, EU ETS, and fleet readiness.
buyer.10.title: My Trades
buyer.10.content: Track orders and completed trades, including confirmation status and trade history.
buyer.11.title: Notifications
buyer.11.content: Stay updated on trade confirmations, price alerts, and compliance deadlines. You're all set.
supplier.0.title: Welcome to Verdaxis!
supplier.0.content: The compliance-first marketplace for verified sustainable marine fuels. Let's take a quick tour of your Supplier Console.
supplier.1.title: Command Center
supplier.1.content: Your operational hub. See outstanding orders, recent trades, inventory levels, and revenue performance at a glance.
supplier.2.title: Intelligence Map
supplier.2.content: See approved trading corridors and port-level demand context for the products you supply.
supplier.3.title: Marketplace
supplier.3.content: Review buyer demand, post supply, and respond to bid-side liquidity in the selected product and port.
supplier.4.title: Forward Curve
supplier.4.content: Monitor live spot depth, indicative forward prices, activity, and alerts for benchmark pricing.
supplier.5.title: Indicative Curve
supplier.5.content: Visualise the forward price path for the selected product and delivery point without treating it as a futures market.
supplier.6.title: Market Activity Feed
supplier.6.content: Follow new orders, price crossings, and matched trades as the market updates.
supplier.7.title: Price Alerts
supplier.7.content: Set threshold alerts to track when a market reaches your target pricing level.
supplier.8.title: Watchlist
supplier.8.content: Save product-port-window slices you want to monitor for demand and liquidity changes.
supplier.9.title: Regulations
supplier.9.content: Review regulatory status and buyer compliance drivers, including FuelEU Maritime and EU ETS.
supplier.10.title: Analytics
supplier.10.content: Review sales performance, revenue trends, and market position to refine supply strategy.
supplier.11.title: My Trades
supplier.11.content: Track completed and in-progress trades, delivery confirmations, and trade history.
supplier.12.title: Notifications
supplier.12.content: Real-time alerts for new orders, price changes, and platform updates. You're all set.
